findings.title: Type narrowing breaks callers that pass integers
findings.body: The new signature restricts `sku` to `str`, but `stockroom/receiving.py` line 12 calls `normalize_sku(barcode)` with an `int`. This will raise `TypeError` at runtime. Either restore the union type `str | int` or update all callers to convert to string before calling.

findings.title: Redundant type guard after narrowing
findings.body: The function now enforces `isinstance(sku, str)` even though the signature already declares `sku: str`. The guard is redundant and can be removed to simplify the body.

summary.problem: The function’s type signature breaks existing callers and adds an unnecessary runtime check.
summary.done_well: The docstring clearly describes the canonical form and the function now validates input types.
